name: EPL Ltd
title: EPL Ltd - 500135 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +17.6% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.4% with capex of INR 480 crore+ ahead of demand, but management gave no numeric Middle East cost-recovery figure and guided only 11-13% growth long term.

capex.quote: capex for this year, we have spent INR 480 crores-plus, which reflects the investments that we are making in B&C

triggers.label: Capex INR 480 cr vs depreciation INR 385 cr
triggers.quote: capex of INR480 crores this year versus depreciation of INR 385 crores

triggers.label: Middle East cost pass-through, ~50% contractual
triggers.quote: With nearly 50% of our business covered under contractual pass -through arrangements

triggers.label: Beauty & Cosmetics +30% YoY
triggers.quote: the momentum was led by Beauty & Cosmetics, which delivered a record 30% year -on-year growth

guidance.quote: Steady state, I expect our tax rates to be in the range of 18% to 22%

prior_guidance_check.quote: Revenue grew by 13%, in line with our commitment to deliver consistent double -digit growth.

red_flags.label: Capex running ahead of depreciation
red_flags.quote: we will pull back , we will do the phasing of the capex investments

red_flags.label: No numeric Middle East cost-recovery quantification
red_flags.quote: it's very difficult to give one number because it's different by market

evasions.quote: it's very difficult to quantify to a common global number
it's very difficult to give one number because it's different by market
We don't have any customers in the beverages industry.
